trust.title: What AI does, what code does, and what leaves the building.
trust.description: Sportel uses AI only where it helps and can be checked. Numbers, labels and proof always come from code.
aiItems: Which file column matches which field, with a confidence and a reason.
How to read a free-text question: which passport it routes to, or a single SELECT to check.
At most one clarifying question about an unclear column.
codeItems: Finds the header row, units such as (000 lekë) and TOTALI/Gjithsej rows.
Removes personal columns before profiling and before any AI call.
Computes every indicator value, its lineage and the reconciliation with the file total.
Runs the plausibility checks and produces the signals.
Sets the label of every answer: verified, exploratory, not answerable, blocked.
Writes answer text from templates; the AI never writes a digit.
trust.modeLive: AI LIVE: the model is called for mapping and questions; every call is logged below.
trust.modeRules: RULES: there is no AI key. Mapping uses synonyms and similarity (confidence capped at 0.6) and free-text questions are not interpreted. Nothing is sent outside.
limits: Every formula is our reading of the public passports until the Performance Unit or AMVV validates it; until then it is marked "draft".
Indicators 41–52 are computed nationally by AMVV from Ministry of Finance data; Sportel does not compute them.
A missing input is marked "not computable" with its owner named; it is never estimated.
Owners are placeholder roles; names are confirmed with the municipality.
Sportel proves consistency and lineage, not that a department's file is true.
The export is SMP-shaped until we receive AMVV's real template.
Low-confidence mappings always need a click.
Only headers, profile statistics and masked samples go to the model, never rows.
Without a model, mapping falls back to rules and the indicators compute the same way.
Sportel predicts no grant points or money and is not an official submission channel.
The data in this demonstration is synthetic (SINTETIKE), not real municipal data.
trust.logDescription: Every AI call is logged with a summary of what was sent. Never rows: only headers and masked samples.
trust.logEmpty: No AI calls. In RULES mode nothing is sent outside.

trust.evalMissing: The evaluation has not been run yet.
